questions.question: What famous statement of hope appears in the middle of Lamentations 3?
options: Our days are filled with weeping, and there is no comfort to be found
The LORD has cast off his people and remembers them no more for ever
The steadfast love of the LORD never ceases; his mercies are new every morning
The crown has fallen from our head; woe to us, for we have sinned greatly
questions.answer: The steadfast love of the LORD never ceases; his mercies are new every morning
